verdict.rationale: Composio is driven programmatically through documented SDK calls such as `composio.sessions.create` and `composio.mcp.create`, plus session configuration options and signed webhook trigger delivery. A probe confirms a published OpenAPI spec at docs.composio.dev/openapi.json and an llms.txt, so the public API surface is machine-readable and documented. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of driving the REST API end-to-end, and evidence of the OpenAPI spec's actual endpoint coverage beyond its existence.
